sentence: No peanut lands right without a gotu beside you in the dark.

wombos.definition: A GOAT unc — an older man who is widely regarded as the greatest or most legendary of his kind.
wombos.example: Everyone at the reunion looked up to him — he's the gotu.

wombos.definition: Peak cinema bronut — the ultimate cinematic snack experience, where the film and the treat consumed during it both reach their peak simultaneously.
wombos.example: Fresh bronut, perfect film — we achieved full peanut that night.
